title: GEMglColorMask
description: enable and disable writing of frame buffer color components

messages.description: nonzero to write red into the frame buffer
nonzero to write green into the frame buffer
nonzero to write blue into the frame buffer
nonzero to write alpha into the frame buffer

arguments.description: nonzero to write red into the frame buffer
nonzero to write green into the frame buffer
nonzero to write blue into the frame buffer
nonzero to write alpha into the frame buffer

body: [GEMglColorMask] calls glColorMask() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glColorMask in the OpenGL reference.
